# Paterson Termite Experts

> Professional termite control, foundation inspection, soil treatment, and structural wood defense services in Paterson, New Jersey and throughout Passaic County.

## Core Services

- [Termite Inspection](https://termitecontrolpaterson.online/services/termite-inspection): Structural foundation inspections, subterranean mud tube diagnostics, and official WDO/WDI NPMA-33 real estate reports.
- [Drywood Termite Treatment](https://termitecontrolpaterson.online/services/drywood-termite-treatment): Specialized timber injection, borate foam applications, and structural wood preservation.
- [Residential Termite Control](https://termitecontrolpaterson.online/services/residential-termite-control): Customized foundation perimeter barriers and protection plans for single and multi-family homes in Paterson.
- [Termite Bait Station Installation](https://termitecontrolpaterson.online/services/termite-bait-station-installation): Advanced subterranean monitoring stations and Sentricon colony elimination.
- [Termite Prevention Services](https://termitecontrolpaterson.online/services/termite-prevention-services): Soil barriers, preventative chemical treatments, and annual inspection plans.
- [Emergency Termite Control](https://termitecontrolpaterson.online/services/emergency-termite-control): Immediate dispatch for active subterranean termite swarms and urgent structural threats.
- [Emergency Pest Control](https://termitecontrolpaterson.online/services/emergency-pest-control): Fast response pest extermination services across Paterson and Passaic County.
- [Termite Damage Assessment](https://termitecontrolpaterson.online/services/termite-damage-assessment): Evaluation of structural wood integrity, subfloor joists, sill plates, and support beams.
- [Wood Treatment for Termites](https://termitecontrolpaterson.online/services/wood-treatment-for-termites): Deep timber preservative applications and wood rot prevention.
